name: electrolytic-smd
title: Aluminium electrolytic capacitor, SMD
summary: Vertical-chip aluminium electrolytic capacitor: a black PA9T seat plate bevelled at the + corners, two flat matte-tin terminals in grooves under it, and the aluminium can with its seal bead, rounded rim and inlaid black negative print (can_diameter, height, base_length, base_width, base_height, base_bevel, span, terminal_gap, terminal_width, lead_thickness, bead_height, bead_depth, rim_round).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); saved at Panasonic's size code D from the public FK series datasheet (Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors (SMD Type), 06-Dec-19, dimensions p. 1; industrial.panasonic.com, a copy at https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/426/DOC042426188.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026): Ø6.3 × 5.8 mm, seat plate 6.6 mm, 7.8 mm over the terminals, terminals 0.65 mm, 1.8 mm apart; seat plate height, bevels, terminal thickness, bead and rim estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
